name: evolvix
description: Skills that let Claude do the weekly coaching work in Evolvix: check-in reviews, nutrition by training day, programs, and logging for clients.

plugins.name: evolvix-coach
plugins.description: For coaches: review check-ins, answer messages, prepare client calls, set nutrition by training day, build programs, import a client's past weights, build check-in forms, keep the exercise library, and keep track of every client through the Evolvix connector.

plugins.name: evolvix-client
plugins.description: For clients of an Evolvix coach: log food, training and weight from a sentence, do your check-in, and see today's plan.
